title: Keryx Memory Reliability P1 — Pure Recall and Explicit Reports

AC1.note: Pure search no longer writes artifacts or returns required report paths; caller and typed fake migration compiles.

AC2.note: report.ts renders bounded relative-only DTOs and validates the checked-in report-schema contract before publication.

AC3.note: Injected report store tests cover unique runs, collision rejection, atomic directory publication, and stale temporary cleanup.

AC4.note: CLI default text and JSON purity tests pass; --save-report writes and returns run ID plus report paths.

AC5.note: Unified risk:read, MCP mutating:false, native adapter, and built-in subprocess default argv are covered by passing tests.

AC6.note: KERYX_P0_ENFORCE=1 focused enforcement passed across service, CLI, harness/unified, MCP, approval, and flow context.

AC7.note: Embedding semantic rerank and no-network suites pass with lexical fallback intact.

AC8.note: Changed-test run passed 37/0, full test run passed 1853/0, and tsc --noEmit passed; health WARN regression is pre-existing/non-P1.
